---
title: Manage User
description: >-
  View account details, and quickly update profile information or delete admin
  accounts.
---
## Step

1. Navigate to Settings > User > User List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="301" height="181" style="width: 301px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click on a specific user to view or trash button to delete user.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="598" height="238" style="width: 598px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3.

- Modify user profile details, such as their username, password, or contact email.

* Click Delete User to permanently revoke a user's access to the system.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="368" height="255" style="width: 368px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
